key_insight: PhyCAD trains text-to-CAD models to prioritize jointly satisfying geometric and physical constraints rather than geometric correctness alone.
engineering_relevance: The framework connects editable CAD generation to finite element verification, helping screen generated designs for specified engineering requirements.
method: Generate executable CadQuery programs from text specifying geometry, loads, and physical constraints.
Verify candidates through program execution, geometric checks, and finite element analysis.
Train with hierarchical GRPO advantages that prioritize verification status while ranking progress within each level.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports a dataset linking parametric CAD to engineering specifications and consistent gains in joint constraint satisfaction across multiple language models, but provides no quantitative results.
watch_item: Reliability depends on the CAD–CAE verifier and fidelity of the loading conditions and finite element models.
paper_title: PhyCAD: Physics-Aware Text-to-CAD Generation via Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning
